265121419_b454a596.text: .Unlike the dLGN, the vLGN is predominantly populated by GABAergic neurons [7][8][9] and does not project to the visual cortex 7

265121419_4a1ce05e.text: .Morphological properties in that dendric arbors of individual vLGN neurons cover a much larger breadth than dLGN neurons 6 can partially explain this feature of vLGN neurons.
